claim: Across fresh isolated Python processes, the registered M097 subtraction operation makes bounded addition acquisition possible, registered addition makes bounded weighted-addition acquisition possible, the lineage conserves and reuses all three operations on nine fresh real-Python worlds, live predecessor mutation or ablation breaks downstream capability, and exact rollback restores the cumulative chain.
falsifiers: Any frozen protocol, pool, mechanism, checker, projection or predecessor binding moves.
The nine-world population is incomplete, reuses a predecessor world, or crosses the execution boundary before freeze.
B is available without A, C is available without registered B, or an unregistered B changes reach.
The operation census is not 0/1/2/3, a prior definition changes, or the exact A/B/C signatures are not conserved.
Any of the three fresh worlds for A, B or C fails after S3.
Any migration, acquisition, control or execution is non-isolated, imports a project module or exposes the repository search path.
A new definition contains a host binary operator or does not retain its live predecessor call.
A digest-valid A mutation leaves B working or a digest-valid B mutation leaves C working.
Removing A or B or corrupting state does not fail closed.
The live S2 fault leaves C available, exact S2 rollback fails, or the post-rollback S3 differs.
The two-file capsule or 24-process census changes, PID records are absent, or the key cycle processes are not distinct.
Stable replay changes a scientific field, an unlisted field must be removed, the result is overwritten or rerolled, or model, network, remote or dirty-tree evidence enters Track A.

cumulative_chain.selection: shortest body then canonical body digest

mechanism.digest_rule: sha256 of canonical JSON mapping each listed path to its raw sha256

qualification_apparatus.digest_rule: sha256 of canonical JSON mapping each listed path to its raw sha256

qualification_population.construction: all nine authored post-M099 structures, three per conserved operation; no draw, exclusion, salt or reroll

owner_authorization: The project owner explicitly confirmed PUBLIC_AGPL_COMMERCIAL_OPTION for M100 on 2026-08-22 and instructed continuation of cumulative repetition with local-first validation.
verdict_rule: positive only when all twelve frozen conditions are computed and true
